title: Annotatio III §.VIII: Werenfels reduces their opinions to a dozen (German Concio on the Sacred Supper)
pass_a_gloss: But their number reduced to a dozen by our Werenfels, in the German Concio on the Sacred Supper, p. 30.
pass_b_english: Our Werenfels trims that heap to a dozen.
Source: his German Concio on the Sacred Supper, p. 30.
source_text: Verò eorum ad duodenarium redactis numerum per Werenfelsium nostratetem, Concione de Sacra Coena Germ. p. 30.

lemmas.gloss: German Concio on the Sacred Supper
